newsitem.title: USA: U.S. December personal incomes post strong gain.
newsitem.headline: U.S. December personal incomes post strong gain.

text.p: Individual incomes grew at the fastest rate in six months during December, the Commerce Department said on Monday, as strong job growth fueled brisk spending.

Incomes from wages, salaries and all other sources were up 0.8 percent to a seasonally adjusted annual rate of $6.64 trillion after a 0.6 percent November increase. Personal spending increased 0.5 percent in December to a rate of $5.27 trillion following a 0.4 percent rise in November.
